query:curve_at_x_extremum_label.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible method label as a string
query:curve_at_x_extremum_label.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of [x,y] pixel points on the plotted markers compared at the requested x-value

query:threshold_series_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the requested count as an integer
query:threshold_series_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of [x,y] pixel points on the method markers that satisfy the threshold at the requested x-value

query:panel_point_threshold_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the requested count as an integer
query:panel_point_threshold_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of [x,y] pixel points on every plotted marker in the requested subplot that satisfies the threshold

query:panel_curve_threshold_crossing_cou.answer_hint: set "answer" to the requested count as an integer
query:panel_curve_threshold_crossing_cou.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of [x,y] pixel points on every curve-threshold crossing in the requested subplot

query:cross_panel_delta_extremum_label.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible subplot label as a string
query:cross_panel_delta_extremum_label.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an object mapping each subplot start/end role to the [x,y] pixel point for that method at the requested x-values

query:cross_panel_threshold_earliest_lab.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible subplot label as a string
query:cross_panel_threshold_earliest_lab.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of [x,y] pixel points on each subplot's threshold crossing for the requested method

query:curve_intersection_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the requested count as an integer
query:curve_intersection_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of [x,y] pixel points at the visible intersections of the two requested methods; use an empty array if there are no intersections

query:earliest_maximum_panel_label.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible subplot label as a string
query:earliest_maximum_panel_label.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of [x,y] pixel points on the maximum marker for the requested method in each subplot
